name: The Tackle Bench
description: Fit parts to a rod, read its rating and weak-link warnings.

pages.title: The Tackle Bench
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Put a rod in and fit a part in each slot; a **3D preview** shows the rod.
- It shows what the rod is **rated** for and warns about the **weak link**.
- Buttons set the **drag** and the float depth.
- Parts also go on by right-clicking the rod with them in your inventory.
Iron sheets, string, planks and a crafting table. Like a crafting table it keeps nothing: the rod comes back with its parts when you close it.

**Slots**: rod or pole, reel, line, leader (optional), hook, float/sinker/lure, bait. A pole has no reel slot. Taking a part out of its slot takes it off the rod.\
\
The panel shows the rating, "fish to about" a weight, the longest cast and the metres of line.

**The rating** is the weakest of three: the blank's load, the line's test (or the leader's) and the reel's top drag. "Fish to about" is the heaviest average fighter that rating lands with a sensible drag.\
\
A new rod's drag starts at a third of the reel's range.
**Float depth**: 0.5 to 8 m, 1.5 m at first. Bites are rolled where the bait hangs, just above the bottom at most, so fish that keep above or below a height see its real depth.

**Weak-link warnings:**

- drag over the line's test: a hard pull snaps it
- drag over what the rod holds: it gets overloaded
- a pole's line stronger than the pole: a big fish breaks the pole
- a rig too light or heavy for the rod: casts fall short
- a worn rod or reel, a frayed line

**Without the bench.** In your inventory, pick up a part or bait and right-click the rod with it: it goes into its slot. Right-click the rod with an empty cursor to take the bait back off.\
\
A rod missing a part says so on its tooltip: "Needs a reel", "Needs line", "Needs a hook, or a lure".

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** set the drag to about a third of the line's test. A careful angler lands most river and lake fish on Iron or Steel gear; tuna, arapaima and sharks need the Heavy Boat Rod with heavy line and a Big-Game reel.\
\
Rods and reels aren't repaired at the bench.
